credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Tall dead tree stump with silhouette portrait of O'Keeffe sitting up against it in the lower viewer right.   This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (Georgia O'Keeffe and Tree)
